Stop paying the 5–9% CPU tax of sidecar proxies just to monitor Kubernetes network egress and cloud spend. 💸

I broke down how to build a zero-overhead FinOps anomaly detector using eBPF kernel tracepoints (kprobe/sys_enter_sendto) and a lightweight Golang daemon (cilium/ebpf)—cutting node overhead to <0.3% with sub-100ms detection.

Full C + Go code & benchmarks:https://aidevtoolkit.blogspot.com/2026/11/zero-overhead-cloud-finops-in-2026.html

#Kubernetes #eBPF #Golang #FinOps #LinuxKernel #DevOps #CloudNative #Observability
